content: Idempotent batch pipeline design: tie each run to a deterministic key (e.g., source_id + run_date) so re-running produces the same rows, not duplicates. Preferred pattern for batch/daily jobs is overwrite-by-partition (delete+reinsert or upsert on natural key) rather than blind append. Use a dedupe/seen-store (unique constraint or checkpoint table) to skip already-processed items on retry. Make writes atomic per unit of work so partial failure doesn't leave mixed state. Corroborated across Prefect, dataskew.io, dev.to, and independent blog sources.
